import re,os,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bar: vertical line of >=3 distinct nonzero colors, width 1
    # bar columns: columns where nonzero cells are contiguous vertically with distinct colors
    from collections import Counter
    # locate bar: pick column with max count of nonzero and where colors distinct
    bar=None
    for c in range(W):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        nz=[x for x in col if x]
        if len(nz)>=3 and len(set(nz))==len(nz) and all(col[i]==0 or True for i in range(H)):
            # check contiguity
            idx=[i for i,x in enumerate(col) if x]
            if idx==list(range(idx[0],idx[-1]+1)):
                bar=(c,idx[0],idx[-1]); break
    bc,r0,r1=bar
    colors=[g[r][bc] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # find shape cells (nonzero, not bar)
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] and c!=bc]
    cols_set=set(c for _,c,_ in cells)
    # group by color
    bycolor={}
    for r,c,v in cells: bycolor.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    # base shape: use color appearing in bar colors (the one present)
    present=[v for v in bycolor if v in colors]
    base=present[0]
    pts=bycolor[base]
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for c,r in [(c,r) for r,c in pts]]
    top=min(rs); left=min(cs); height=max(rs)-top+1
    rel=[(r-top,c-left) for r,c in pts]
    idx_of_base=colors.index(base)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,col in enumerate(colors):
        off=(i-idx_of_base)*height
        for dr,dc in rel:
            out[top+off+dr][left+dc]=col
    return out

    for r in range(H-2):

    c0,c1=barcols

           if g[r][c] and not (barrows[0]<=r<=barrows[1] and c0<=c<=c1)]
    bycolor={}

    pts=bycolor[base]
    top=min(r for r,c in pts); left=min(c for r,c in pts)
    height=max(r for r,c in pts)-top+1
    rel=[(r-top,c-left) for r,c in pts]
    ib=colors.index(base)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
